subject: A Tamil woman drawing a traditional white rice-flour kolam at the entrance of her ancestral home

setting.place: Chettinad, Sivaganga district, Tamil Nadu, India
setting.architecture: Traditional Chettinad courtyard with carved teak wooden pillars, Athangudi tiles and a spacious entrance

lighting: Soft natural dawn light with warm brass lamp illumination
style: Ultra-realistic cinematic documentary photography, authentic Tamil cultural details, natural textures and realistic human proportions

motion.subject_motion: The Tamil woman slowly draws a traditional kolam using rice flour while her saree moves gently in the morning breeze
motion.camera_move: Slow cinematic push-in towards the kolam
